title.zh: 对《 一般银行法》的修改
title.orig: An Act to Amend Section Fifty-Three of Republic Act Numbered Three Hundred Thirty-Seven, Otherwise Known as "The General Banking Act"

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1967/ra_4879_1967.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Section fifty-three of Republic Act Numbered Three hundred thirty-seven is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 53. Mutual building and loan associations may purchase, hold, and convey real estate under the same conditions as those specified with reference to commercial banks in Section twenty-five of this Act. They may also acquire real estate for subdivision into residential lots, on each of which it must construct and erect a residential house for disposition by sales or lease exclusively to their members: Provided, That each association shall not invest more than twenty-five (25%) percent of its paid-in capital and surplus in the acquisition of real estate for subdivision purposes: Provided, further, That a member of any building and loan association shall acquire not more than one residential lot, subdivided under this Section: Provided, finally that the acquisition and resale or lease of real estate as provided for in this section shall be subject to the approval of two-thirds of all the members of the Board of Directors of the associations."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1967.
